order: Build the dispatch layer over the existing registry as a router module at the repo root. Transcribe the plan's casting tables — rungs, roles, the hard never-rules, the computed review matrix, the degradation ladder, the automatic-trigger rules — into a data file the router reads rather than hardcodes; every rung must match an independent transcription of the source table exactly, checked in both directions. The route function must fail closed on any ownership-invariant violation — it must never resolve a role through a broken registry. Reviewer selection must compute no-self-family status from the full co-author set, and unattributed or mixed-family authorship must fail closed, never dispatch open. A missing required companion task must block the dispatch entirely; dispatch may proceed only once every required companion exists. Mark any default the plan leaves silent as an explicit unstated choice — never guess silently. Wire the new suite into CI and keep the gate-class order fixed: cross-vendor review before merge, unchanged.
claims: 74 checks went green, including a 9,375-call sweep across all 625 bucket-state combinations confirming no mandatory-class dispatch ever produces a same-family closing verdict — every non-close case typed DOES_NOT_CLOSE. No-self-family behavior was checked for every author-family combination, and an independent bidirectional transcription check confirmed every rung matches the source table. Fail-closed loading was tamper-tested against registry corruption, never-rule violations, vendor/family mismatches, and off-ladder inputs; CI runs the suite.
